name: chalk
notes: Case: a tiny repository whose only documentation is its README, imported as one repository (docs inside the repo). Ground truth = README changes between v5.3.0 and v6.0.1 that the visible v6.0.1 code supports. source/vendor is ignored by the importer, so FORCE_COLOR and RGB downsampling (#FF0000 → 91) are left out. Badges, sponsors, FAQ, origin story and the dependents count are not code facts. Three changes are planted from chalk's own older API (v4): chalk.Instance, the keyword color model and the argument separator; they test removed and contradicted statements.

mutations.replace:
- [`ansi256`](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ANSI_escape_code#8-bit) - Example: `chalk.bgAnsi256(194)('Honeydew, more or less')`
- [`keyword`](https://www.w3.org/wiki/CSS/Properties/color/keywords) (CSS keywords) - Example: `chalk.keyword('orange').bold('Orange!')`

mutations.find: Multiple arguments will be separated by space.
mutations.replace: Multiple arguments will be joined without a separator.

items.what: Both the level option and the level property throw for anything that is not an integer from 0 to 3; omit the option or pass undefined to detect the level.
underlineColorNames is exported as well; underline color names are not part of colorNames.

items.anchor: - `underline` - Put a horizontal line below the text. *(Not widely supported)*
items.what: New modifiers underlineDouble, underlineCurly, underlineDotted and underlineDashed.
Underline colors (underlineRed, underlineBlackBright alias underlineGray/underlineGrey, …) exist; they only show together with an underline style.

items.anchor: Background versions of these models are prefixed with `bg`
items.what: Underline versions of the color models: underlineHex, underlineRgb, underlineAnsi256.

items.anchor: will downsample an RGB value of #FF0000 (red)
items.what: ansi256 values are downsampled to 16 colors at level 1 as well.
There is no chalk.Instance; a new instance is created with new Chalk({level: 0}) imported as {Chalk}.
The keyword color model does not exist; only rgb, hex and ansi256 are supported (usedModels).

items.anchor: Multiple arguments will be joined without a separator.
items.what: Multiple arguments are joined with a space (strings.join(' ')).
